sources.title: 人脸识别技术应用安全管理办法
sources.publisher: 国家互联网信息办公室、公安部
sources.usage: Supports necessity review and a reasonable convenient non-face alternative where the same purpose can be achieved without face recognition.
sources.limitations: Does not mean all facial recognition is unlawful or create a housing right; applicability is matter-specific.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-63-4 Digital Identity Guidelines
sources.publisher: US National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.usage: Background comparison for deciding whether real-world identity is needed before selecting assurance.
sources.limitations: US technical guidance is not Chinese law and does not validate this concept.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1183 on the European Digital Identity Framework
sources.usage: Background comparison for selective disclosure, voluntary use, and retained alternatives.
sources.limitations: EU law is not a Chinese compliance basis; the framework is not anonymous service.
